Should I self-host or use Cloud?

Self-hosting is free and gives you full infrastructure control, but you manage updates, backups, and scaling yourself. Cloud removes all of that. Fully managed, with automatic upgrades and email support included. Most teams start on Cloud and never need to self-host.
Yes. Cloud includes a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
How do I choose the right instance size?
Use the cost estimator above to find the right instance based on your document count, search volume, and document size. You can upgrade or downgrade your instance at any time.
Can I self-host Meilisearch for free?
Yes. Meilisearch is open source under the MIT license. You can deploy it on your own infrastructure with no usage limits.
I need to self-host for compliance reasons. Can I still get dedicated support?

Yes. If regulatory, security, or data residency requirements mean you can't use Cloud, you can self-host Meilisearch on your own infrastructure and still get a dedicated support agreement, an SLA, and access to advanced features. Contact our team to discuss your requirements.
How do I get help choosing?
Talk to our team. We'll look at your traffic, document volume, and growth plans and recommend the model that costs you the least over time.
